patterns: APPSC asks single-fact agent questions: stalactites/stalagmites formed by groundwater; till/moraine/boulder clay = glacial; which agent forms a delta, cirque, cliff, dune (match).
Strong AP tilt: karst caves (Belum vs rock-cut Undavalli/Bojjannakonda/Erravaram), Borra, Billa Surgam district, Arwah caves in Meghalaya.
Other PSCs repeat: bird's-foot delta = Mississippi, hanging valley = glacier, blind valley/sinkhole = karst, maximum coastal erosion = waves, Bhabar/Terai, lacustrine plains.
App MCQs go deeper than PYQs with multi-statement and match items on drumlins, loess sources, delta density and coast types; most are sound textbook facts.
